risks.proof: A close-up photo of the DOT code on the sidewall (week/year).

risks.risk: Hidden damage: sidewall cuts, internal puncture, or prior repair not visible from this angle.

Close-up of the DOT date code (week/year).
Photos of both sidewalls and both shoulders (front/back) to check for cuts, patches, and bulges.

response.reason: The photo does not allow confirmation of the exact tire size/brand or the DOT date, and the key condition claims (90% tread, no patch/bulge, 2023 origin) are not verifiable from the single image. Without those, a correct worst-case price cannot be set confidently.
